title: AI Story Book Environment Variables
description: Required and optional environment variables for AI Story Book deployment

PROD_API_URL.description: Public HTTPS API origin for deployment health/smoke and mobile release; no trailing slash. This is an operator/mobile setting, not an API Settings field.

PRIVACY_POLICY_URL.description: Public HTTPS privacy policy page, required for release preflight and passed explicitly to the mobile build with --dart-define=PRIVACY_POLICY_URL=<URL>. A hosting provider address is allowed; a custom domain is not required. Operator/mobile-build setting only: do not add to backend Settings or forward through API/worker Compose environment. Page access without login and legal content need separate live verification.

TERMS_OF_SERVICE_URL.description: Public HTTPS terms of service page, required for release preflight and passed explicitly to the mobile build with --dart-define=TERMS_OF_SERVICE_URL=<URL>. A hosting provider address is allowed; a custom domain is not required. Operator/mobile-build setting only: do not add to backend Settings or forward through API/worker Compose environment. Page access without login and legal content need separate live verification.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: 개발 스택(infra/docker-compose.yml) Redis 비밀번호. 비우면 인증 없이 기동(127.0.0.1 바인딩), 값을 주면 --requirepass 가 켜진다.

POSTGRES_HOST_PORT.description: 개발 스택 Postgres 호스트 포트. 로컬 네이티브 postgres 와 충돌하면 5433 등으로 변경.

LLM_API_KEY.description: API key for the LLM provider (required in production)

LLM_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for LLM requests in seconds

IMAGE_API_KEY.description: API key for the image provider (required in production)

IMAGE_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for image generation in seconds

ILLUSTRATION_QUALITY_ENABLED.description: Verify generated illustrations before publication. Required for release with a supported OpenAI vision model; false only for mock/local development.

STT_API_KEY.description: API key for STT provider (OpenAI 등)

PURCHASES_ENABLED.description: Expose new purchases only after account recovery and live store validation; existing receipt verification remains strict

IAP_VERIFICATION_MODE.description: IAP 검증 모드: local(개발), hybrid(키 있으면 실검증), strict(실검증 필수)

GOOGLE_PLAY_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Google Play Developer API access token

GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE.description: Path to Google service account JSON file

GOOGLE_PLAY_VERIFY_BASE_URL.description: Google Play verify API base URL

S3_REGION.description: S3 signing region applied to uploads and signed downloads. Use the exact provider/project region.

S3_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL prefix for S3 objects

RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.description: Mutation requests per account per sliding window; excludes read-only polling

USE_CELERY.description: Use Celery for background tasks (true for production)

MAX_PENDING_JOBS.description: 대기열 상한을 넘으면 신규 생성 요청을 차단

FREE_PLAN_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED.description: 무료 플랜 정책 강제 여부 (월 생성 한도/스타일/PDF·오디오 제한)

FREE_PLAN_ENFORCE_IN_TESTING.description: TESTING=true 환경에서도 무료 플랜 정책을 강제할지 여부

FREE_PLAN_MONTHLY_BOOK_LIMIT.description: 무료 플랜 월 생성 권수 제한

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins, or '*' for all

S3_DOWNLOAD_ENDPOINT.description: Client-reachable S3 API endpoint for signed downloads; never rewrite the signed host to a CDN.

S3_DOWNLOAD_TTL_SECONDS.description: Lifetime of owner-authorized media download URLs.

POD_ORDERING_ENABLED.description: Expose order placement only after fulfillment validation; requires POD_MODE=strict in production.

PHOTO_PROCESSING_ENABLED.description: Explicit operator gate after child-data provider and retention conditions are verified. Does not itself prove approval.

PHOTO_ANALYSIS_PROVIDER.description: Separate photo/drawing analysis provider; no inherited writing-provider fallback.

PHOTO_ANALYSIS_API_KEY.description: Dedicated approved photo-analysis project API key. Required for enabled live photo processing.

OPENAI_IMAGE_QUALITY.description: Explicit GPT Image output quality for image generation and reference edits. Does not affect Gemini or DALL-E requests.

DATABASE_SSL_MODE.description: Shared API/Celery/Alembic PostgreSQL TLS policy. Empty preserves URL/driver defaults; external deployment requires verify-full.

DATABASE_SSL_ROOT_CERT.description: Readable provider CA PEM path inside the container. Used with verify-ca/verify-full. External Compose mounts infra/certs at /run/storybook-certs.

DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL.description: Optional direct PostgreSQL URL for Alembic only; otherwise DATABASE_URL is used. Same TLS policy applies; never use transaction pooler.

S3_ADDRESSING_STYLE.description: Identical bucket addressing for uploads and signed downloads. Supabase S3 requires path.

S3_AUTO_CREATE_BUCKET.description: Create a missing bucket in local/self-hosted storage. External deployment requires false and a pre-created private bucket.

RATE_LIMIT_READ_REQUESTS.description: Read-only requests per account per sliding window, including job polling

PROVIDER_OBSERVATION_TTL_SECONDS.description: Cached provider response observation lifetime; expiration becomes unverified. Health probes never invoke paid AI.

PROVIDER_USAGE_PRICES_JSON.description: Optional JSON object of per-model reference token/image rates. Missing rates are unknown; estimates are not invoices.
